text.description:
{Angelic Alliance}

Increases all four primary skills by +21. Allows the hero to mix creatures from {good} and {neutral} factions without a morale penalty. Casts Expert Prayer at the start of combat that last 10 combat rounds.

{Titan's Thunder}

Increases attack and defense skills by +9, and power and knowledge skills by +8. Hero gains the ability to cast {Titan's Lightning Bolt} for 600 points of damage, does not cost any spell points, adds a spell book into their inventory (permanently).

{Power of the Dragon Father}

Increases all primary skills by +16, grants +1 to morale and luck. All troops are {immune} to 1-4th level spells.
